liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

Debt due within a year declined by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, which cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2024}} cover, so the near-term maturities do not require new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}, leaving FCF after leases to debt at {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}.
The group issued a bond in May 2024, whose proceeds sit among the year's cash flows.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, and FCF after leases to debt dropped by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, so cash left for debt holders is thin against the investment programme.

Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}} but lower than a year earlier.
Maturities: debt due within a year of {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}} is covered by cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2024}}, but the buffer narrowed as cash fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}}.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}, which keeps pressure on free cash flow.
